userStories.title: AI Desk & RAG Knowledge Repository Administration API
userStories.description: Implement administrative AI Desk and RAG knowledge endpoints supporting embedding maintenance, company facts lifecycle, and chat transcript audit triage
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/ai-desk/summary returns vector embedding metrics (total, products, FAQs, company facts), chat audit triage counts, and confidence stats
POST /api/v1/admin/ai-desk/reindex triggers full catalogue vector reindexing with audit log and returns indexed/skipped counts
GET /api/v1/company-facts/admin returns company knowledge facts with category, verified, and public filtering
POST /api/v1/company-facts/admin creates new verified company fact and syncs vector embedding
GET /api/v1/ai/admin/audit-logs returns paginated visitor chat transcripts with confidence, intent, and resolution filters
PATCH /api/v1/ai/admin/audit-logs/:id/resolve resolves flagged query with staff resolution note
RBAC restricts re-indexing and fact creation to admin and editor; chat triage accessible to sales

userStories.title: AI Knowledge Base & Chat Review Desk UI with RAG Maintenance

Fact editor drawer features category dropdown, fact key, formal label, value content, source document attribution, and verified status toggle

userStories.title: Automated AI Desk Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify AI Desk and Knowledge Base features with integration tests and confirm zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAiDeskSummary, triggerAdminReindex, fetchAdminCompanyFacts, createAdminCompanyFact, fetchAiChatAuditLogs, and resolveAiChatAuditLog
Automated integration tests in server/tests/ai-admin.test.js cover AI desk summary, RAG reindexing, company fact lifecycle, chat audit log resolution, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
